title: Tameable Bees — Ручные Пчёлы
description: Tameable bee. Follows you, protects you, and collects pollen. A new companion on your adventure
body:
##  Tameable Bees

**Now you can tame bees!**

This mod adds a new type of bee that can be tamed with any flower. They follow you, protect you, and collect pollen.

###  How to tame
Use any flower on a special bee (found in hives). 33% chance to tame.

###  Features
- Follow owner / Stay mode
- Protect owner from attackers
- Call nearby bees for help
- Unique textures with chocolate and purple colors
- Custom spawn egg

###  Warning
Tamed bees may still attack you if provoked. Be nice!
